content.short: Hyward is a yield protocol operating on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Hyward runs yield strategies on Hyperliquid, part of the cluster of vault protocols that formed on the chain once HyperEVM made general smart contracts possible alongside the native order book. Its value locked places it among the smaller but active protocols on the network.
content.meta: A yield protocol among the smaller but active deployments on Hyperliquid.
